text: Bitcoin's 5.7% gain is solid, but Ethereum's 9.3% surge suggests rotation into alts and renewed confidence in smart contract platforms. The Fear & Greed index at 46 with a sharp 7-day climb indicates sentiment is shifting from panic toward cautious optimism, supported by the $82B daily volume. BTC dominance holding at 57% shows the market isn't fragmenting—Bitcoin remains the anchor while traders are willing to take on slightly more risk in the broader ecosystem.
